protocol.adaptive: Half uniform midpoint samples plus deterministically ranked valid-depth discontinuities; no truth labels or semantic regions.
protocol.timing: Measured offline CPU computation using current exact self-filter and canonical mapper; small timing hooks included. Input loading, evaluation truth rasterization and output I/O excluded.
protocol.geometry: Exact evaluation box/sphere/Z-cylinder intersections label matched native optical depth and endpoint cells after sampling/masking only; AABBs label ROI counts separately. No truth enters selection or integration.
protocol.source_age: Original captured phase clocks retained where present. Otherwise explicit logical replay age1ms; no native publication/freshness/rate inference.
protocol.unknown: UNKNOWN is neither obstruction nor collision. Adapter output is verified to contain only original observed OCCUPIED, unexpired cells.

cases.initial_condition: All policies start with UNKNOWN in independent fresh maps at the first selected original input; omitted earlier capture history is not recreated.
